glsa.title: Flatpak: Multiple Vulnerabilities
glsa.synopsis: Multiple vulnerabilities have been found in Flatpak, the worst of which allows sandbox escape.

background.p: Flatpak is a Linux application sandboxing and distribution framework.

description.p: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in Flatpak. Please review the CVE identifiers referenced below for details.

impact.p: Please review the referenced CVE identifiers for details.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All Flatpak users should upgrade to the latest version:
